parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Pinned
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to pin the report. Valid values:

*   **false**
*   **true**

parameters.name: ReportStatus
parameters.description:
The state of the report. Valid values:

*   **0**: disabled
*   **1**: enabled

parameters.name: ReportType
parameters.description:
The type of the report. Valid values:

*   **0**: daily report
*   **1**: weekly report
*   **2**: monthly report
*   **3**: report whose statistics are collected in a custom time range

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-customize-report-list --lang zh --report-status 1 --report-type 0 --title test --report-version 2.0.0 --pinned false --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeCustomizeReportList --region cn-hangzhou --ReportVersion '2.0.0' --Pinned false --Title test --Lang zh --ReportStatus 1 --ReportType 0
